Append values to the trace

Source: R/trace.R
append_trace.Rd

Method used for appending values to the states and variables slots of a trace-class. Note that this method can only append a single additional state to the trace.

Usage

append_trace(object, state, ...)

# S4 method for class 'trace,ANY'
append_trace(object, agents = NULL, variables = NULL)

# S4 method for class 'trace,state'
append_trace(object, state)

Arguments

object

Object of the trace-class to which you would like to append the values of states and variables.

state

Object of the state-class containing the current state that you would like to append to the trace.

...

Additional arguments specified in the methods.

agents

List of instances of the agent-class containing the agents at the current state. Defaults to NULL, meaning meaning no agents are found at the current trace.

variables

Named list containing the values of the variables at the current state. Defaults to NULL, meaning no variables are currently tracked in the trace.

Value

Object of the trace-class with appended values for its slots states and variables. Note that if both the arguments agents and variables are NULL, empty lists are added to both slots.

See also

agent-class, state-class, trace-class
